name: Heatwave
summary: Five days of fierce heat: homes and farms want far more water. Keep the taps running without breaching the abstraction licence.
briefing: A heatwave is forecast for the next five days, and the river authority has issued a drought order: the town may take only 3 Ml a day from the river, and no new intakes will be licensed.
Keep at least 99% of customers supplied on average, and do not take more than the licence allows. Gardens, showers and cooling push household demand up, and farms on the mains are irrigating hard.

Your levers: water restrictions in the budget panel (Shift+B): a hosepipe ban, or a ban on irrigation from the mains as well (residents and farmers will not like either), and storage: the water tower covers the peaks, and more storage gives you time if anything fails. Press O for the pressure overlay.

constraints.noNewFacilitiesReason: No new abstraction licences are being granted while the drought order is in force.

events.text: Heatwave and drought order: 3 Ml a day from the river. Demand for water will climb every afternoon.
The treatment works has tripped out in the heat. Until a water crew fixes it, only storage keeps the taps running.
Two days to go. Farms are at peak irrigation: watch the abstraction figures on the water chip.
